subject.title: feat(chat): UX-012 — token usage progress meter

question: Should this PR be ported as a second composer-base token meter, or should the existing context-usage dial be the accepted UX-012 implementation?
rationale: Current main already has context usage visibility, while this PR adds a parallel meter and still has a stale-token display blocker; protected maintainer-labeled feature work needs an owner decision.

options.title: Port with shared model
options.body: Keep the 2px meter idea, but require a rebase onto the current chat components and reuse the freshness-aware context notice model.

options.title: Treat current dial as UX-012
options.body: Close or supersede this stale branch after deciding that current main's context-usage dial is the intended solution.

recommendation.title: Port with shared model
recommendation.body: Keep the 2px meter idea, but require a rebase onto the current chat components and reuse the freshness-aware context notice model.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored this UX-012 branch and has adjacent Control UI UX history, making them the best available feature-direction contact from the likely-owner set.
